hero.subtitle: Save on subscriptions by joining the world's largest co-subscription community.

landing.howDesc: We connect subscription owners with co-subscribers looking for an available seat, while guaranteeing complete transaction security.
landing.cosubscribersDesc: Access subscriptions you are interested in and enjoy it. No strings attached.
landing.testimonialsSubtitle: Find out how our users are spreading the word!
landing.faq1A: You only pay for your share of the subscription. By splitting the cost with others, everyone pays a fraction of the full price—so you get the same access for less.
landing.faq2Q: Is it legal to share subscriptions via CostLyf?
landing.faq2A: Yes. CostLyf connects people who want to use the family or multi-user plans that providers already offer. You're sharing within the terms of those plans, so it's fully legal.
landing.faq3A: Yes. We handle payments securely and protect your data. You only share what's needed to join or host a group, and we don't store your payment details on our servers.
landing.faq4Q: Can I cancel or stop sharing a subscription?
landing.faq4A: Yes. You can leave a group or stop offering a seat at any time. Access continues until the end of the current billing period, and there's no long-term commitment.
landing.faq5Q: Do I lose my favorites when I share my subscription?
landing.faq5A: No. When you share a subscription, you keep your own profile, watchlist, favorites, and history. Co-subscribers have their own separate profiles—nothing is shared except the cost.
landing.faq6Q: What happens if, after I've paid, my subscription access doesn't work?
landing.faq6A: Contact our support team. We'll help you resolve access issues and, if the problem is on our side, we'll sort out a refund or credit. Your payment is protected when you use CostLyf.
landing.footerLegalText: CostLyf is registered as a payment service provider agent. Subscription sharing is subject to the terms of each service provider.
